remarks: Move-in Ready! One-Bedroom Condo in the Desirable Springdale Neighborhood of Stamford! Discover this charming one-bedroom condo located in this sought-after neighborhood, bordering Darien and New Canaan. Enjoy the super convenience with the train station just across the street and shopping and restaurants right outside your front door. Springdale area boasts a delightful Mom & Pop Town vibe. This updated unit features hardwood floors throughout, and is freshly painted, making it ready for immediate move-in. It's a fantastic opportunity for investors with low common charges that include heat and hot water. The prime location, close proximity to the train station, and local amenities make it incredibly fast & easy to rent. Don't miss out on this exceptional opportunity!
